actions.action: Preserve permission changes as dated events
actions.mechanism: Append grants and withdrawals instead of overwriting records, retaining the permission state applicable to each display.
actions.implementation: Store asset ID, venue/date scope, recorded time, and effective time. Link withdrawals to affected grants; retain dated display logs.
actions.check: Record an authorized display, then withdraw future permission. Confirm the past display remains authorized and later dates are blocked.
actions.risk: Incorrect effective times can misclassify displays.

actions.action: Reconcile offline packing manifests before installation
actions.mechanism: Treat offline packing as provisional movement, never as permission to display.
actions.implementation: Cache versioned venue/date permissions for the offline workday. Record packed asset IDs and destinations; synchronize and compare every entry before installation.
actions.check: Withdraw permission while packers are offline. After synchronization, confirm the affected print is flagged and installation remains blocked pending resolution.
actions.risk: Missing manifest entries could evade reconciliation; scan every print.

actions.action: Require a current venue check before display
actions.mechanism: Separate physical delivery from authorization by checking each asset against its intended venue and display dates.
actions.implementation: Use an asset-ID-only public label. At installation, query current permissions for the scheduled interval; hold denied, unknown, or unreconciled prints.
actions.check: Test correct venue, wrong venue, withdrawn permission, and unavailable service. Only a currently authorized, reconciled print passes; labels contain no contact details.
actions.risk: Unavailable verification delays installation; do not substitute cached approval.

actions.action: Locate and isolate withdrawn prints inside shipments
actions.mechanism: A container-to-asset index turns withdrawals into actionable shipment holds without requiring staff to unpack everything.
actions.implementation: Link each packed asset to a container and destination. Queue withdrawal holds for packing and receiving staff, requiring a scanned disposition.
actions.check: Withdraw a print already packed for another venue. Confirm staff identify its container and record removal or quarantine before installation.
actions.risk: Repacking makes locations stale unless container assignments are updated.
